tasks.build: deno task build-assets && deno run -A --minimum-dependency-age=0 steno build && deno run -A scripts/write-robots.ts
tasks.dev: deno task build-assets && deno run -A --minimum-dependency-age=0 steno dev
tasks.check: deno check --config theme/scripts/deno.json theme/scripts/*.ts && deno check scripts/build-assets.ts scripts/write-robots.ts
